name: Offer A
text:
FUNDINGFIT SYNTHETIC BUSINESS LOAN OFFER
Offer A
This fictional offer is educational sample data, not a bank quotation.
Purpose: purchase of equipment for a small business.
Currency: EUR.
Principal amount: EUR 100000.
Nominal annual interest rate: 3.50%.
Rate type: fixed for the entire loan.
Loan term: 60 months.
Repayment: equal monthly instalments, payable at each month-end.
Upfront arrangement fee: EUR 5000.
Fee payment: paid separately at drawdown; not financed in the loan principal.
Insurance: none.
Guarantee fees: none.
Broker fees: none.
Other costs: none.
No payment holiday, balloon payment, or deferred interest applies.

evidence.rate_type: Rate type: fixed for the entire loan.

name: Offer C

Offer C

The principal and interest are repaid through equal monthly payments in arrears.
Initial application fee: EUR 1500.
The initial fee is paid separately at disbursement, outside the loan amount.
No insurance is charged.

No broker fee is charged.
